title: All WARN-tier token-economy hooks emit on a channel the model never receives (stderr + exit 0) — 4 guards are silent no-ops [CONFIRMED]
mechanism: cascade-read-check (P1-CASCADE/KIT-011), context-budget-warn (KIT-018), docs-staleness-check (S64 operator WARN decision), pertask-state-warn (KIT-013) all print warnings to stderr and exit 0. Per Claude Code hook semantics, PreToolUse stderr is fed to the model ONLY on blocking exit 2; UserPromptSubmit injects STDOUT (not stderr) into context on exit 0. So the agent that is supposed to change behavior (use offset/limit, run /compact, update docs/SPRINT_STATE) never sees the warning.
evidence: (1) kit/hooks/lib/cascade_check.py:41 `file=sys.stderr` + wrapper kit/hooks/cascade-read-check.sh:12-13 `|| true; exit 0`. (2) kit/hooks/context-budget-warn.sh:54-63 all `>&2`, :66 `exit 0` (UserPromptSubmit — stdout would be injected, stderr is not). (3) kit/hooks/docs-staleness-check.sh:103 `cat >&2`, :121 `exit 0`. (4) kit/hooks/pertask-state-warn.sh:37 `cat >&2`, :42 `exit 0`. (5) Live reproduction this session: `cat llm-wiki/wiki/log.md > /dev/null` (exact banned-file trigger) returned only my own echo — no WARN in tool result; manual invocation of the hook with the identical JSON payload prints '⚠️ CASCADE-WARN: cat/less крупного файла .../log.md (~240КБ > 50КБ)' and exit 0 — hook fires, output dropped. (6) Scan of ~143MB jsonl (all sessions in ~/.claude/projects/-Users-Apple-Desktop-Vibe-Code-Bot-AI-Traiding-Bot/): 0 organically rendered WARNs; the only rendered 'Context warning: transcript 900KB'/'Context URGENT: transcript 1300KB' strings are a manual hook test dated 2026-04-26T23:47Z ('=== test 900KB file (yellow warn) ===') and doc-page echoes — despite sessions provably exceeding 800/1000KB thresholds on every prompt (61 autocompactions, transcripts to 126MB) since the hook was installed. (7) Brief item (a) answered: banned-file full-reads post-hook (S62, 2026-07-02) = 0; pre-hook = 8 in main session (6× log.md incl. worktree copies, Apr 20-23) — but the guard as built could not have prevented recurrence anyway.
why_weak: Four token-economy guarantees the kit lists as shipped (S59/S62/S64) are decorative: the S64 operator decision 'docs/=WARN — пуш НЕ блокируется, реши осознанно' presumes the agent sees the warning to decide consciously; it cannot. In fully autonomous runs (auto-resume, mega-run) even the human-terminal fallback is absent.
proposed_direction: One-line channel fix per hook: context-budget-warn → print to stdout (UserPromptSubmit stdout is context-injected at exit 0); the three PreToolUse warns → emit JSON `{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","additionalContext":"<warn text>"}}` on stdout. Add a regression case to kit/hooks/tests asserting the warn text actually reaches tool-result/context (red/green via real hook invocation, per hook-test discipline).

title: Stale 43.8KB ancestor /Users/Apple/Desktop/CLAUDE.md auto-loads into every session — ~13.3k tokens (41% of boot) of outdated kit audit contradicting shipped state [CONFIRMED]
mechanism: Claude Code loads CLAUDE.md from every ancestor directory of cwd. The repo lives under /Users/Apple/Desktop/, and /Users/Apple/Desktop/CLAUDE.md (43,839 bytes) is the pre-mega-run kit audit ('КИТ — валидация механики спринта...'). It is injected into the system prompt of every session in this repo (observed directly in this session's context, labeled 'project instructions').
evidence: wc -c: /Users/Apple/Desktop/CLAUDE.md = 43,839 B ≈ 13,285 tokens at the kit's own 3.3 B/tok ratio. Total auto-loaded boot = 106,802 B ≈ 32.4k tokens (repo CLAUDE.md 28,768 + llm-wiki/CLAUDE.md 15,614 + ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md 17,375 + Desktop 43,839 + MEMORY.md 1,206) → Desktop file = 41%. Staleness: it prescribes as FUTURE fixes things already shipped in S57-S62 — '§3 P0-REVIEW Фикс. Ввести хук review-gate.sh' (review-gate.sh exists and is registered in ~/.claude/settings.json PreToolUse), 'P0-DOCS: для docs/ — ничего автоматического' (docs-staleness-check.sh + docs-broken-link-check.sh registered), '~22 битых ссылки' (fixed S59/S60 per kit-upgrade-report), '§6 план S57..S61' (all shipped, tags alpha.57-66). No other ancestor CLAUDE.md exists (/Users/Apple, /Users/Apple/Desktop/Vibe_Code, .../Bot all clean) — this is the only stray.
why_weak: Every session pays ~13.3k input tokens to load a document whose recommendations are already implemented and whose claims contradict ground truth (model may re-propose shipped fixes or trust stale inventory numbers 11/6/5). It is outside the repo, outside git, outside kit-inventory and docs-staleness coverage — invisible to every gate the kit built.
proposed_direction: Move the document into llm-wiki (e.g. wiki/project/audits/2026-07-pre-megarun-kit-audit.md, status: superseded by kit-upgrade-report) and delete /Users/Apple/Desktop/CLAUDE.md. Add a hooks-selfcheck/kit-auditor check: enumerate ancestor CLAUDE.md files of repo root and WARN on any outside the expected set (~/.claude, repo, llm-wiki).

title: Model-dispatch guidance contradicting ADR 0076 (uniform fable-5) survives in every boot file and both canon wiki pages [CONFIRMED]
mechanism: ADR 0076 (accepted 2026-07-02) pinned ALL 18 agents to claude-fable-5 and abolished aliases ('Алиасов (sonnet/haiku/opus) в реестре больше нет'). Ground truth verified: `grep '^model:' ~/.claude/agents/*.md` → 18× `model: claude-fable-5`; kit/PINNED_VERSIONS.md → 22 fable-5 lines. But the pin change was never swept through the instruction layer, so every session boots with contradictory dispatch orders.
evidence: Contradicting lines still live: repo CLAUDE.md:274 'model dispatch (sonnet default, opus for judgment-heavy, haiku for mechanical)'; llm-wiki/CLAUDE.md:275 '| Model dispatch | haiku=mechanical, sonnet=standard, opus=judgment | до 50× экономия |'; ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md:82-84 dispatch table ('haiku … sonnet — DEFAULT … opus — escalate'); kit-overview-ru.md:110-122 (the 'single source of truth gateway' per repo CLAUDE.md:126) full per-agent table 'trader-expert | sonnet 4.6 effort:max', 'python-reviewer | haiku', 'security-auditor | **opus**'; tooling-inventory-ru.md:47-48,72,84,95,101,108,115,131,139 ('doc-reviewer agent (haiku, lightweight)', 'Модель: **haiku** (downgraded post-S13 для cost efficiency)'), :462 dispatch table, :486 '❌ Использовать opus где hailku/sonnet работает'.
why_weak: The instruction layer tells the controller to dispatch mechanical work to haiku/sonnet while the operator's binding decision is depth>cost on fable-5. Task-tool dispatches that pass a model alias (bypassing agent-registry pins) would silently violate ADR 0076; at minimum the model burns reasoning reconciling contradictory rules each session. S64's llm-wiki audit closed counter drift but demonstrably did not cover model labels.
proposed_direction: Single sweep commit: replace dispatch tables in the 3 CLAUDE.md files with one line ('ADR 0076: все агенты = claude-fable-5; model dispatch отменён'); regenerate the kit-overview/tooling-inventory agent tables from kit/PINNED_VERSIONS.md — extend kit-inventory.sh AUTO-block to include the per-agent model column so pin-policy changes can never drift again; add a kit-auditor cross-check 'no sonnet/haiku/opus dispatch guidance outside superseded ADRs'.

title: KIT-006 fix incomplete: kit-inventory AUTO-blocks cover only 2 wiki pages — boot CLAUDE.md files still ship wrong counters and wrong sprint state [CONFIRMED]
mechanism: kit-inventory.sh regenerates AUTO-blocks only in kit-overview-ru.md and tooling-inventory-ru.md (kit/kit-inventory.sh:24-25). The files loaded FIRST every session (repo CLAUDE.md, llm-wiki/CLAUDE.md) are hand-maintained and drifted through the entire mega-run.
evidence: Ground truth (kit-upgrade-report): 18 agents, 10 project skills, 14 PreToolUse-Bash hooks, S66 shipped (alpha.66). Boot files say: repo CLAUDE.md:7 '26 skills integrated (13 superpowers + 5 project + 8 agent-skills)'; :34 '9 agents + 26 skills'; :129 '11 reviewer agents + 36 skills + … 7+2+1 hooks'; :138 'Project-level workflow skills (5 total: …)'; :139 'L5 reviewer agents (11: …)'; :146 '**Current state**: Sprint 38 COMPLETE (tag v0.1.0-alpha.38). S39 between sprints' (28 sprints stale). llm-wiki/CLAUDE.md:262 'L5: Domain reviewers (9)', :263 'agent-skills 21', :264 'Superpowers 13'. Three different agent counts (9/11/15+) coexist in one boot file.
why_weak: The count-drift class KIT-006 declared closed ('Дрейф счётчиков как класс исчезает') persists exactly where it is most read — the session boot prompt. Cost is mostly misinformation (wrong sprint state can mislead orient/resume before SPRINT_STATE is read; wrong counts feed manifests and reports), and stale lines get re-quoted by doc agents (observed as file echoes in transcripts).
proposed_direction: Add repo CLAUDE.md and llm-wiki/CLAUDE.md navigation/counter lines to kit-inventory.sh TARGETS with the same `<!-- AUTO:kit-inventory -->` markers; replace the hardcoded 'Current state: Sprint 38' line with a pointer to SPRINT_STATE.md (never a literal sprint number in a boot file).

title: ADR 0074 A/B would burn 2 sprints measuring a knob logs suggest is inert, and its MAX_THINKING tier-scaling arm contradicts ADR 0076 [CONFIRMED]
mechanism: ADR 0074 (proposed) fixes methodology: AUTOCOMPACT 50 vs 65 across 2 comparable sprints; MAX_THINKING '10000 vs масштаб по тиру (haiku 4000 / sonnet 8000 / opus-fable 12000)'. Two defects: (1) no step verifying the env var has ANY effect — the kit's own log analysis (kit-weakpoints line 75) found compactions fired at preTokens min 167k / avg 307k ('CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE=50 в бою почти не проявился'); with a live 200k window and PCT=50 honored, boundaries should cluster near ~100k — none of 61 events were below 167k. (2) The tier-scaled MAX_THINKING arm references haiku/sonnet tiers abolished by ADR 0076 the same day; and the flat MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=10000 cap on an all-fable-5 registry sits in tension with 0076's stated priority 'токен-бюджет НЕ ограничен… максимальная глубина проработки' — it throttles exactly the judgment depth the operator chose to pay for.
evidence: ~/.claude/settings.json:3-4 '"MAX_THINKING_TOKENS": "10000", "CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE": "50"' (mirrored kit/settings.example.json:3-4). ADR 0074:32-36 (A/B design, no validity probe; tier arm). ADR 0076:17,34 (uniform fable-5; 'Экономия тира больше не цель'). kit-weakpoints-from-history.md:74-75 (61 boundaries, preTokens avg 307,854 / min 167,014; compactMetadata.preTokens/postTokens/durationMs available in jsonl).
why_weak: As designed the A/B costs 2 full sprints and can only return noise if the knob is dead; the MAX_THINKING arm tests a model matrix that no longer exists. Impact estimate: if AUTOCOMPACT=50 is inert, today's cost is 0 tokens but a false belief in a tuned guard; if it ever activates on smaller windows it roughly doubles lossy-compaction frequency (each ≈ −92% context + ~2.1 min + re-read tail per kit-weakpoints).
proposed_direction: Cheapest sequence: (0) knob-validity probe, one disposable session, no sprint (~30 min): bulk-Read files to ~55-60% of window, then grep compact_boundary in that session's jsonl — boundary at ~50% ⇒ knob live; boundary at default ⇒ knob dead → delete the env var and close arm A of ADR 0074 without any A/B. (1) Only if live: 2-sprint A/B harvesting existing compactMetadata + per-turn usage from jsonl via a ~20-line grep script (zero new instrumentation). (2) Rewrite the MAX_THINKING arm for the 0076 world: 10000 vs unset (platform default) on fable-5 only; given the depth-over-cost directive the default hypothesis should favor removing the cap.
